ValidationRule.description: Must enter an Inactive or Disqualified reason when Account Status is Deactivated or Disqualified. 01/27/25: Removed System Admin line to force enter a Reason.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", OR( ISPICKVAL( Account_Status__c , "Deactivated"), ISPICKVAL( Account_Status__c , "Disqualified")), ISBLANK( TEXT(Inactive_Reason__c)))
